    Lemma 6.6 for graded Λ_μ-modules #

    lem:square-zero-selected-lifts: "Put Λ_μ = (Λ ⊗_R R[ε]/(ε²), m + εμ), with deg ε = −q. Then each M_i has a graded lift to Λ_μ that is free over R[ε]/(ε²), unique up to a graded isomorphism reducing to the identity. Every homogeneous original map lifts."

    SquareZero.lean records lifts by their first-order equations (ActLift, IsLiftHom). Here a graded lift is a graded Λ_μ-module in the literal sense (MuMod): an R-module L with ε of degree −q, ε² = 0, and an action of Λ (the elements a + 0ε of Λ_μ) commuting with ε, with (l a) b = l(ab) + ε l μ(a, b) (the product of Λ_μ); free over R[ε]/(ε²) (ker ε = im ε), with a graded Λ-linear identification L/εL = M. An ActLift gives the lift M ⊕ εM (ActLift.toMuMod); conversely, a graded section of L → M identifies any such L with the lift of an ActLift (MuMod.exists_model), which gives existence (exists_muMod), uniqueness up to a graded isomorphism reducing to the identity (muMod_unique) and the lifting of maps (muMod_mapLift) in this form.

      Type (max (max u_2 u_3) u_5)

      A graded lift of M to Λ_μ, free over R[ε]/(ε²): ε of degree −q with ε² = 0, an action of Λ ⊂ Λ_μ commuting with ε with (l a) b = l(ab) + ε l μ(a, b) (the product a ⋆ b = ab + εμ(a, b) of Λ_μ), ker ε = im ε, and a graded Λ-linear surjection red : L → M with kernel εL.

      • ε_ε (l : L) : self.ε (self.ε l) = 0
      • act : L →ₗ[R] Λ →ₗ[R] L
      • act_ε (l : L) (a : Λ) : (self.act (self.ε l)) a = self.ε ((self.act l) a)
      • act_one (l : L) : (self.act l) 1 = l
      • act_mul (l : L) (a b : Λ) : (self.act ((self.act l) a)) b = (self.act l) (a * b) + self.ε ((self.act l) ((μ a) b))
      • gr : ZGr L
      • ε_hom (p : ℤ) (l : L) : self.gr.IsHom p l → self.gr.IsHom (p - q) (self.ε l)
      • act_hom (p d : ℤ) (l : L) (a : Λ) : self.gr.IsHom p l → GΛ.gr.IsHom d a → self.gr.IsHom (p + d) ((self.act l) a)
      • free (l : L) : self.ε l = 0 → ∃ (l' : L), l = self.ε l'
      • red : L →ₗ[R] M
      • red_surj : Function.Surjective ⇑self.red
      • red_ker (l : L) : self.red l = 0 ↔ ∃ (l' : L), l = self.ε l'
      • red_hom (p : ℤ) (l : L) : self.gr.IsHom p l → MM.gr.IsHom p (self.red l)
      • red_act (l : L) (a : Λ) : self.red ((self.act l) a) = (MM.act (self.red l)) a

                  Lemma 6.6, existence: under Ext²_Λ(M, M)_q = 0, M has a graded lift to Λ_μ, free over R[ε]/(ε²) (for a normalized cocycle: μ(1, 1) = 0).

                  theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.GExt.muMod_unique {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {Λ : Type u_2} [Ring Λ] [Algebra R Λ] {GΛ : GAlg Λ} {M : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {μ : Λ →ₗ[R] Λ →ₗ[R] Λ} {q : ℤ} {MM : GMod GΛ M} (hproj : ∀ (p : ℤ), Module.Projective R ↥(MM.gr.proj p).range) (h : ExtVanish MM MM 0 q) {L : Type u_5} {L' : Type u_6} [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L] [AddCommGroup L'] [Module R L'] (X : MuMod μ q MM L) (Y : MuMod μ q MM L') :
                  ∃ (Φ : L ≃ₗ[R] L'), (∀ (l : L) (a : Λ), Φ ((X.act l) a) = (Y.act (Φ l)) a) ∧ (∀ (l : L), Φ (X.ε l) = Y.ε (Φ l)) ∧ (∀ (l : L), Y.red (Φ l) = X.red l) ∧ ∀ (p : ℤ) (l : L), X.gr.IsHom p l → Y.gr.IsHom p (Φ l)

                  Lemma 6.6, uniqueness: under Ext¹_Λ(M, M)_q = 0 (and graded pieces of M projective over R, e.g. M free), two graded lifts of M to Λ_μ free over R[ε]/(ε²) are isomorphic by a graded Λ_μ-linear isomorphism reducing to the identity.

                  theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.GExt.muMod_mapLift {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {Λ : Type u_2} [Ring Λ] [Algebra R Λ] {GΛ : GAlg Λ} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {μ : Λ →ₗ[R] Λ →ₗ[R] Λ} {q : ℤ} {MM : GMod GΛ M} {NN : GMod GΛ N} {r : ℤ} (hprojM : ∀ (p : ℤ), Module.Projective R ↥(MM.gr.proj p).range) (hprojN : ∀ (p : ℤ), Module.Projective R ↥(NN.gr.proj p).range) {L : Type u_5} {L' : Type u_6} [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L] [AddCommGroup L'] [Module R L'] (X : MuMod μ q MM L) (Y : MuMod μ q NN L') (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : ∀ (m : M) (a : Λ), f ((MM.act m) a) = (NN.act (f m)) a) (hfdeg : ∀ (p : ℤ) (m : M), MM.gr.IsHom p m → NN.gr.IsHom (p + r) (f m)) (h : ExtVanish MM NN 0 (r + q)) :
                  ∃ (F : L →ₗ[R] L'), (∀ (l : L) (a : Λ), F ((X.act l) a) = (Y.act (F l)) a) ∧ (∀ (l : L), F (X.ε l) = Y.ε (F l)) ∧ (∀ (l : L), Y.red (F l) = f (X.red l)) ∧ ∀ (p : ℤ) (l : L), X.gr.IsHom p l → Y.gr.IsHom (p + r) (F l)

                  Lemma 6.6, maps lift: under Ext¹_Λ(M, N)_{r+q} = 0, a Λ-linear map f : M → N of degree r lifts to a graded Λ_μ-linear map F : L → L' of degree r between graded lifts, reducing to f.

                  theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.GExt.modelHom_iff {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {Λ : Type u_2} [Ring Λ] [Algebra R Λ] {GΛ : GAlg Λ} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {μ : Λ →ₗ[R] Λ →ₗ[R] Λ} {q : ℤ} {MM : GMod GΛ M} {NN : GMod GΛ N} (L₀ : ActLift μ q MM) (L₀' : ActLift μ q NN) (F : M × M →ₗ[R] N × N) :
                  ((∀ (x : M × M) (a : Λ), F ((MM.act x.1) a + L₀.act x.2 a, (MM.act x.2) a) = ((NN.act (F x).1) a + L₀'.act (F x).2 a, (NN.act (F x).2) a)) ∧ ∀ (x : M × M), F (x.2, 0) = ((F x).2, 0)) ↔ ∃ (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : M →ₗ[R] N), IsLiftHom L₀ L₀' f g ∧ ∀ (x : M × M), F x = (f x.1 + g x.2, f x.2)

                  Λ_μ-linear maps between lifts M ⊕ εM → N ⊕ εN are exactly (n, m) ↦ (f n + g m, f m) with f + εg a lifted map (IsLiftHom): so the lifted Hom modules are the equation-form ones, free over R[ε]/(ε²) on lifts of a basis (liftHom_basis).
